Class GraphicsManager

java.lang.Object
dev.marasmium.kit.applib.graphics.GraphicsManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.jogamp.opengl.GLEventListener, EventListener
public class GraphicsManager extends Object implements com.jogamp.opengl.GLEventListener
The main class of the MarasmiumKit application framework's graphics system

    • submit

      public boolean submit(Camera camera, String text, String typefaceFilePath, Box boundingBox, float padding, float depth, float size, Vector position, Alignment horizontalAlignment, Alignment verticalAlignment)
      Submit a string of text to the graphics system for rendering
      Parameters:
      camera - The camera to render the text through
      text - The text to render
      typefaceFilePath - The typeface to render the text in
      boundingBox - The bounding box for the text to be aligned and contained within
      padding - The spacing between the text and the edges of the bounding box
      depth - The depth to render the text characters at in the scene
      size - The scale on the default pixel size of the typeface to draw the text at
      position - The default position to start drawing text at before alignment within its bounding box
      horizontalAlignment - The horizontal alignment of the text within its bounding box
      verticalAlignment - The vertical alignment of the text within its bounding box
      Returns:
      Whether the text was submitted successfully
